general.title: General
general.restartHint: Some menu items that macOS adds itself (like Writing Tools and Emoji & Symbols) change language after Garam restarts.
general.openRepositoryInHint: A repository already open in another window brings that window to the front.
general.commitChecksHint: Before committing, Garam looks for secrets, large files and files that usually aren't committed.
general.baseNotices: Tell me when the base branch moves ahead
general.baseNoticesHint: When the default branch (such as main) your branch was made from gets many new commits, or something that would conflict, a notice shows above your changes.
general.confirmConflictingPull: Ask before a pull that would conflict
general.confirmConflictingPullHint: When pulling would conflict, Garam shows the files and asks first. Pulls without conflicts go straight ahead.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.accentSystemHint: Uses your system's accent color, adjusted to stay readable.
appearance.accentSystemUnavailable: Garam can't read the accent color on this system, so it uses Garam green.

git.title: Git
git.hint: These are saved in your global Git configuration, so the command line uses them too.
git.name: Name

apps.title: Apps
apps.editorHint: To use a different editor for one repository, choose it under “Default Editor for This Repository” in the “Open in” menu.

sync.title: Sync
sync.hint: Background fetches never ask for credentials. If signing in is needed, fetch from the toolbar.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.hint: Sign in to GitHub to push and pull without pasting a token. You can sign in to more than one account, such as a work and a personal one.
accounts.codeCopied: Your code is copied. Paste it on the GitHub page that opened in your browser, then approve Garam.
accounts.codeManual: Enter this code on the GitHub page that opened in your browser, then approve Garam.
accounts.waiting: Waiting for you to approve in the browser…
accounts.revokeHint: Signing out removes the token from this computer. To also revoke Garam's access, go to <settings>GitHub settings</settings>.

saved.title: Logins remembered on this computer
saved.hint: For remotes signed in with a username and password or token, saved when you chose “Remember on this computer”. They're kept in the system keychain. Forget one and Git asks for it again.
